# Ec stem

> Early childhood STEM education provider in Singapore delivering playful, hands-on robotics, science, engineering and math learning for preschoolers aged 4-6.

Ec stem partners with preschools and enrichment centres across Singapore to bring STEM to life through the Self-Ecstem Methodology. Programmes are aligned with Singapore's NEL Framework and built around three core pillars: FIX-IT, Applied INNOVATION, and CONSCIENTIOUS Making.
